A few useful answers.

A clear starting point for exploring the products, the platform, and a potential collaboration.

01What is Solarity AI?+

Solarity AI LLC, based in Irving, Texas, builds AI self-improvement apps for iOS and Android: Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max. Building them shaped three web apps for teams that build mobile products: Engineering Max, Management Max, and Marketing Max. Ata Turhan is the founder.

Link to this answer

02Which products can I explore today?+

Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max have live App Store and Google Play listings. Fitness Max is listed in app stores as Only Fitness. Their product pages link to the stores for current offers and availability in your region.

Link to this answer

03How quickly has Solarity AI shipped?+

Four apps launched on the App Store in twelve weeks: Looks Max on June 23, 2026, Fitness Max (listed as Only Fitness) on August 15, 2026, IQ Max on September 11, 2026, and Sleep Max on September 16, 2026. Each is also on Google Play. See the shipping record.

Link to this answer

04Who builds Solarity AI?+

Founder Ata Turhan leads Solarity AI from Irving, Texas, with Emrecan Özkan, Ali Yılmaz, Hasan Ak, Eren Öz, Batuhan Yücetürk, and Melik Kaplan. Meet the team.

Link to this answer

05Can other teams use the web apps?+

Yes, at different stages. Management Max is open with a free plan for one app. Engineering Max is in private testing and Marketing Max is in early access; both take requests on their own sites. Mobile versions of all three are planned.

Explore the app factory or discuss the web apps for your team.

Link to this answer

06What is the business model direction?+

The consumer apps use subscriptions and in-app purchases. Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max have store listings with in-app purchases; consult each listing for current plans and terms.

Management Max offers a free plan and paid plans that count apps, not seats. Engineering Max and Marketing Max have no price yet.

Link to this answer

07What kinds of partnerships are relevant?+

We welcome conversations about product distribution, technology collaboration, and platform design partnerships. A useful introduction describes your audience or team, the product or workflow involved, and the collaboration you have in mind.

Start a partnership inquiry.

08How do I start a conversation?+

Choose an investor inquiry or partnership inquiry. The contact page opens your email app with the relevant subject, so you can write directly to the founder.

You can also email ata.turhan@solarityai.com directly or use the founder’s booking link on the contact page.
